validation.validationMethod: EDR bus slice 1 (dedicated reader -> in-process pub/sub bus -> PersistenceSubscriber). Ships DARK behind pi.bus.enabled (default false): the full fast suite must stay green with the flag off (zero behavioral change on merge). The load-bearing acceptance gate is the byte-identical golden master -- realtime_data rows written via the bus path equal rows written via the existing inline logReading path. Hardware-independent (stdlib only, existing OBD path) -- does not wait on the IMU/light sensors or the ECMLink spike. Strangler-fig: display, drive detector, and the sync transport are untouched (later slices 2-5). Post-merge flag-flip on the Pi (confirm byte-identical realtime_data + healthy sync) is a separate PM/CIO deploy gate.
